passages.excerpt_preview: odern work on Ashoka examines the relation between material remains, inscriptions, Buddhist traditions, colonial decipherment and national memory.
The recovery and decipherment of Brahmi inscriptions made the historical identification of Piyadasi with Ashoka central to modern Indian historiography.
